agent: main session, for OpenHOI3's Strategic Effects window, 2026-10-14
question: Which element of a Strategic Effects row answers with the trigger block's tooltip - the maintainer saw it only on the '?' icon

addresses.name: CTriggeredModifierItem::IsInfoIcon
addresses.comment: **Slot 22 of CTriggeredModifierItem's second table (object offset 0x1C): whether an element is this row's `modifier_info`, the '?' icon.** `this` is the row's +0x1C, so `[ecx+0x1C]` is the row's +0x38, which the constructor (0x2D0F50) fills with `modifier_info`. CTriggeredModifiersView_ElementTooltip asks it of each row and hands the tooltip to the one that answers, so **only the '?' of a row has the trigger block's tooltip**. 0x6D15F0 to the `ret 4` at 0x6D15FF. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-countrymodifier.md, section 3.
addresses.evidence: Listing 0x6D15F0-0x6D15FF: `mov edx, [ebp+8]; xor eax, eax; cmp edx, [ecx+0x1c]; sete al; ret 4`. vtable.py --holding 0x6D15F0: CTriggeredModifierItem slot 22 in the table at 0x15D2DE4, object offset 28. The maintainer's look at the original, 2026-10-14: the tooltip shows only on the '?'.

addresses.name: CTriggeredModifiersView_ElementTooltip
addresses.signature: bool __stdcall CTriggeredModifiersView_ElementTooltip(void* window@EAX, CGuiObject* element@stack:4, GuiTooltipText* out@stack:8) @EAX
addresses.comment: **The Strategic Effects window's tooltips** - the window at CInGameIdler +0x1D4C, which CInGameIdler::GetElementTooltip asks while it is shown. Hands the element to each row of its list (+0x24) in turn through the row's CTriggeredModifierItem::IsInfoIcon (slot 22 of its table at +0x1C), and the first that answers - **the row whose `modifier_info`, the '?', the element is** - gets its tooltip through CTriggeredModifierItem_Tooltip (0x6D14D0); answers whether one did. So only a row's '?' has a tooltip. Was IdlerWindow1D4C_ElementTooltip until 2026-10-14, when the window was identified. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-countrymodifier.md, section 3, and reversing/findings/FINDINGS-unitpaneltooltips.md, section 1.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled: the walk over the list's rows calling `[[row+0x1C]+0x58]` with the element, then FUN_006d14d0(out, row, out). Slot 0x58/4 = 22 of the row's table at +0x1C is 0x6D15F0, which compares the element with the row's +0x38 alone.
addresses.revises: The comment said every element of a row gives the same text, taking the row's slot 22 for 'holds the element' unread. It is CTriggeredModifierItem::IsInfoIcon, which answers only for the row's modifier_info - as the maintainer saw in the original.

addresses.name: CTriggeredModifierItem_Tooltip
addresses.comment: **A Strategic Effects row's '?' tooltip: the row's modifier's `trigger` block's account of itself.** Called for the row whose `modifier_info` is under the mouse (CTriggeredModifierItem::IsInfoIcon). Where the row holds a modifier (+0x28) and a country is played, it makes a CEventScope of the player's country and assigns to `out` what slot 9 of the CAndTrigger at modifier +0x88 writes - CAndTrigger::GetBlockText with `redWhen` false and depth 0, the text a technology's allow block gives. Otherwise nothing. 0x6D14D0 to the `ret 8` at 0x6D15DF; ECX is set by the caller and not read. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-countrymodifier.md, section 3.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled: `if (*(item + 0x28) != 0)`, the player's tag into a CEventScope, `call [[modifier+0x88]+0x24](out, scope, 0, 0)`, assignString to the second stack argument; `ret 8`. The listing loads [ebp+8] at 0x6D14E1 before touching ECX.
addresses.revises: Says which element it is for: the row's '?' alone (CTriggeredModifierItem::IsInfoIcon), where the comment implied any element of the row.
